role: Berserker: conjured blood weapons, fuelled by bleeding enemies and held blood; never pays in the caster's own health.
reflux_why: Unchanged. The blood that is out does the work and essence only steers it; what limits a berserker is how much blood is out, not how hot it runs. Between Life's 1.0 and Death's 1.4 it would be hot; it is low because the fuel is the enemy's blood, not the caster's essence.
rule: Blood works blood that is already out: its hits open Bleeding, bleeders spill pools, and you hold what you drink (up to 10 measures); every measure you hold makes your blows 2% harder (Bloodrush), and blood skills spend Bleeding, pools or held blood - never your health. Blood never heals.
rule_why: The 2026-10-22 rule kept, plus Bloodrush: the berserker's meter is the blood it holds. Holding blood makes you hit harder; spending it buys the big moves (longer blood weapons, Outpour, Red Frenzy). That tension - hold or spend - is the role. Brent's ruling stands: nothing spends the caster's health, and blood never heals (healing is Life's; Blood is what Life loses).
band_shift: Strikes on the heavy side for a melee role (weapon strikes 1.3-1.5x every swing, finisher 2.2x plus 20 a stack), costs cheap to mid (7-12) because held blood is the second fuel. Ranged damage stays light (lancet 50).

skills.name: Red Lancet
skills.summary: A thin blade of essence thrown along your aim. The first enemy it hits takes 50 and starts Bleeding (2 stacks).
skills.verb_fit: It opens a cut; the Bleeding it leaves is where every other blood skill gets its blood. Parent: Life (the living body opened; only what lives bleeds).

new_mechanics.name: bleeding, blood_pool, held_blood
new_mechanics.definition: Unchanged from the 2026-10-22 draft (blood.json red_lancet), already in statuses.json and the world scripts.

new_mechanics.name: bloodrush
new_mechanics.definition: Affinity rule key damage_per_held_blood 0.02: every hit the player deals is x (1 + 0.02 x held blood), read at the moment of impact like fire's heat_mult; +20% at 10 held. Shown as the held-blood beads glowing.

good_modifiers.word: it cuts through the whole line
a second cut into an open one: +25% against a bleeder
a cut across the throat: interrupts and Chokes

bad_modifiers.why: closing wounds on the skill that opens them; only the reflux cut lands.
a lancet thrown at yourself; it falls back to a small damage bonus.

skills.name: Tourniquet
skills.summary: For 6 s no blow opens a wound on you: each one that would have spends 2 blood instead - from a pool within 3 m of you first, then from what you hold. The blow still takes health from the bar; with no blood to spend, the wound opens as usual.
skills.verb_fit: Staunching stops the flow before it starts, paid for with blood already spilled. It keeps the berserker in the fight. Parent: Life (the body's own wounds closed).
skills.change: Pools within 3 m pay first (pool_radius), so the berserker standing in the blood of the fight keeps its held blood for attacks.

new_mechanics.name: pool_radius
new_mechanics.definition: A skill key: when the skill spends blood, blood pools within pool_radius of the caster are drunk first (one measure each, as Drink), then held blood.

good_modifiers.word: a tourniquet that holds half as long again
a bind of hardened blood: Braced as you tie it

bad_modifiers.why: spilling is the opposite of staunching; it only makes the buff dearer.
a self buff hits nobody; both halves fall back to a small cost cut.

skills.name: Deep Draught
skills.summary: Drink it in at once, without stopping: one Bleeding stack is drawn out of every bleeding enemy within 6 m (12 damage each) and every blood pool within 4 m is drunk. Each stack or pool becomes 1 held blood (up to 6 from one cast).
skills.verb_fit: Drink is taking blood in: this fills held blood from what is already out. Parents: Life (the blood of the living, drawn out of their cuts) and Death (the dead's pools, spilled blood that stays useful).
skills.change: Was a 4 s channel at 60% walking speed; a berserker refuels between swings, so it is now an instant pulse.

new_mechanics.name: field_pulse on pools and bleeders
new_mechanics.definition: death.json's field_pulse on the caster's own field pieces, here blood pools (any pool counts; the floor's blood is nobody's) within pool_radius, plus on_hit to every enemy within radius carrying the consumed status; each piece or stack taken gives blood_per_take held blood, at most max_take.

good_modifiers.word: drawing the blood draws the body: bleeders dragged 1.5 m in

bad_modifiers.why: giving blood out while drinking it in; the word contradicts itself.
clotted blood cannot be drunk; only a small damage bump lands.

skills.name: Outpour
skills.summary: Pour every measure of held blood out in a cone 6 m long: 30 damage plus 18 for each measure spent (210 with all ten), 1 Bleeding, and the floor where it lands runs with fresh pools.
skills.verb_fit: Spill is giving blood out as a weapon: the whole reserve, thrown, landing as more spilled blood. It is the berserker's choice to give up Bloodrush for one blow. Parent: Death (a killing flood, and the blood it leaves stays useful).

good_modifiers.word: a jet instead of a wave
a flood that knocks them back
a flood that finishes the dying: +30% on the Dying

bad_modifiers.why: drinking back what you pour out; contradicts itself.
a closed wound spills nothing; only the reflux cut lands.

skills.name: Clotblade
skills.summary: A wide sweep as cleavers of hardened blood form in your hands: 1.8x strike damage in front of you, and every Bleeding stack on a target sets hard in the cut for +22 damage and +12 poise (those stacks are spent). Then you keep the clotblades for 8 s - 1 s more for each held blood you spend, up to 4: your strikes do 1.5x and half again the poise damage, and each strike opens 1 Bleeding.
skills.verb_fit: Clot is blood hardening into blades: the conjured weapon is clotted blood. Parents: Life (the living's blood, hardened) and Death (a cleaver that turns open cuts into killing wounds).
skills.change: Role shaping: the sweep now conjures a blood weapon (8 s, longer with held blood) that your strikes use. Kept the sweep, so it is still the close starter.

new_mechanics.name: conjure_weapon
new_mechanics.definition: A skill key: for lasts seconds (plus extend_per_blood per held blood spent at cast, up to spend_blood_max) the player's bare strikes use the conjured weapon instead of the main hand: melee damage, range, arc and poise multiplied or replaced by its melee_* keys, and on_strike added to each strike's payload. The worn weapon is hidden (ModelRig.set_weapon) and comes back when it ends. One conjured weapon at a time; a new one replaces the old. Only Blood conjures weapons.

good_modifiers.word: the sweep leaves a fresh cut: 1 Bleeding on everything hit
the heart drives the swing: quicker and harder
the blades hold half as long again

bad_modifiers.why: it closes the cuts the blade is meant to harden; only the reflux cut lands.
thinning the blood you are hardening: lighter blades for a little reach. The words fight.

skills.name: Thinblood Rush
skills.summary: A fast 4.8 m dash that slips between bodies, cutting each one you pass for 15 and 1 Bleeding. Every blood pool you cross carries you 1.5 m further (up to +3 m), and you move 20% faster for 2 s after.
skills.verb_fit: Thin is blood running quick: you run as thin blood runs, and spilled blood is road for you. Parents: Life (vigour, speed) and Death (the dead's pools carry you).
skills.change: Role shaping: each body you pass is cut (15 and 1 Bleeding), so the berserker's dash opens the fight.

good_modifiers.word: you rush inside a shell of hardened blood: Braced
deeper cuts on the way through: 1 more Bleeding

bad_modifiers.why: a slowed heart on a rush; Sluggish lands on what you pass, but the word fights itself.
no damage worth concentrating and no reach field to shorten; it falls back.

skills.name: Red Frenzy
skills.summary: Your heart pounds: for 8 s you strike 25% faster, move 25% faster, hit 20% harder and reach 0.4 m further, and light blows cannot stagger you. Every kill gives you 2 held blood. The first 3 s are free; after that it burns 1 held blood every 2 s, and it ends early when you run dry - never on your health.
skills.verb_fit: Pulse is the heart pounding: here it is your own heart, and the frenzy is the berserker's core. Parents: Life (the body driven past itself) and Death (each kill feeds it).

new_mechanics.name: red_frenzy
new_mechanics.definition: A buff on the player: attack_rate_mult on bare strikes (their cooldown and a conjured weapon's), move_speed_mult, damage_mult, strike_reach_bonus metres on bare strikes, poise_loss_mult; each kill gives kill_blood held blood.

new_mechanics.name: upkeep_blood_per_s
new_mechanics.definition: A self_buff key: after upkeep_grace_s the buff spends held blood at this rate; when held blood is 0 it ends at once. It never touches health.

good_modifiers.word: the heart keeps pounding half as long again
a frenzy that finishes the dying

bad_modifiers.why: a slowed heart cannot pound; the verbs cancel and the word should not form.
a calm frenzy is no frenzy; the reflux cut lands and the word says nothing.

skills.name: Heavy Heart
skills.summary: Point, 9 m: a 3 m circle for 6 s where hearts slow. Enemies in it are Sluggish (30% slower, wind-ups half again as long, bleeding slower) and take 8 a second. Every blood pool the circle touches goes still too and does the same for its 6 s.
skills.verb_fit: Still is the heart slowing; the spilled blood it touches carries the slowing out. Utility: crowd control for a melee fighter. Parent: Death (the heart slowing toward its end).
skills.change: 8 damage a second inside, so the ascension power aspect has a field.

bad_modifiers.why: a pounding heart in a field of slow ones; only the extra reflux lands.
hurrying a skill whose point is slowness; it falls back.

skills.name: Gullet Knot
skills.summary: One enemy within 10 m: its own blood knots in its throat. 30 damage and interrupted. If it is Bleeding it is Choked for 2.5 s (1 s if not): it cannot attack, shoot, cast or call for help, and walks at half speed.
skills.verb_fit: Choke cuts off breath through an open cut. Utility: the berserker's answer to an archer or a drummer it cannot reach. Parent: Death (breath stopped).

good_modifiers.word: the knot holds half as long again

bad_modifiers.why: giving breath to the throat you close.
one throat at a time; the damage loss lands.

skills.name: Long Breath
skills.summary: Breathe out up to 4 blood - pools within 3 m first, then what you hold: each takes 6 off your hottest reflux at once. Then for 6 s your poise is refilled and doubled, and reflux sheds twice as fast.
skills.verb_fit: Breathe steadies the body: the berserker's second wind between frenzies. Parent: Life (breath, a steadied body).
skills.change: Pools within 3 m pay first (pool_radius, as Tourniquet).

good_modifiers.word: a breath held half as long again

bad_modifiers.why: cutting off the breath the skill gives; nobody to land on.
a frenzy is the opposite of a long breath; the cost rise lands.

skills.name: Thirsting Glaive
skills.summary: Blood draws out into a long glaive in your hands for 10 s: your strikes reach 3.6 m in a 70 degree sweep at 1.3x, and each strike that lands on a bleeder draws 1 stack out of it into held blood. It swings faster the emptier you are: up to 30% faster with nothing held.
skills.verb_fit: Thirst is the hunger for blood, and the glaive is that hunger in your hands: it drinks with every strike, and hungers hardest when you hold least. Parents: Life (the living's blood drawn out) and Death (a reaping reach).

new_mechanics.name: empty_rate_bonus
new_mechanics.definition: A conjure_weapon key: strike rate x (1 + empty_rate_bonus x (1 - held / held_max)), so the bonus is full at 0 held blood and gone at 10. It pulls against Bloodrush: the glaive likes you empty, Bloodrush likes you full.

good_modifiers.word: the glaive holds half as long again
each strike opens a cut as it drinks

bad_modifiers.why: a thirst that is already slaked; the bonuses are on the Dying and the bleeding, which the glaive drinks dry. The words fight.
giving out the blood the glaive takes; the word contradicts itself.

skills.name: Last Draught
skills.summary: One enemy in reach: 2.2x strike damage and +20 for each Bleeding stack on it (spent), 30% more if it is Dying. One left under 15% of its health dies outright if it was Bleeding (not elites). If it dies, its blood is yours: its stacks plus 3 as held blood.
skills.verb_fit: Sate is drinking a body to the dregs: the finisher that ends a bleeder and takes all its blood. Parents: Death's Kill (finish the dying, execute below 15%) and Life (the body's blood taken whole).

new_mechanics.name: execute_needs
new_mechanics.definition: A strike key beside death.json's execute_below: the execute only applies if the target carries that status when the blow lands (read before consume_status takes it).

new_mechanics.name: kill_blood
new_mechanics.definition: A skill key: if the hit kills, the caster gains kill_blood held blood, plus kill_blood_per_stack for each stack the skill consumed.

new_mechanics.name: dying_mult
new_mechanics.definition: A skill key: x dying_mult against a Dying target (statuses.json derived below_half), as Death's affinity rule does for every Death skill.

good_modifiers.word: a pounding finish: quicker and harder
+25% on a bleeder, a little more reach

bad_modifiers.why: closing the cuts you mean to drain; only the reflux cut lands.
a thirst on the skill that slakes it; the words fight.

skills.name: Hammering Heart
skills.drop_reason: Pulse now beats in the caster's own heart (Red Frenzy), the berserker's core. Hammering Heart was a 10 m caster detonation; paying out Bleeding belongs to the berserker's reach (Clotblade and Last Draught spend stacks in melee, Outpour spends held blood). Pulse could carry it as a second skill, but it would pull Blood back toward a ranged caster.
skills.summary: Every Bleeding enemy within 10 m: three beats, 8 per stack each (2026-10-22 draft).

effects.Thin: speed x1.25; reach x1.1; power x0.9
effects.Pulse: windup x0.8; power x1.1; reflux x1.1
